verdict.rationale: Docs show Slate can run multiple subagents in parallel/background, perform integration tests, and work across long sessions, which covers 'build and test' autonomously, but there is no evidence of a cloud-hosted execution environment or of any built-in 'demo' artifact (preview links, recorded runs, etc.) for reviewer consumption. missing for 10: evidence of cloud-hosted (vs local CLI) agent execution, an explicit demo/preview generation feature, and end-to-end review workflow beyond background task running.
